t: What Cardinality Estimation Internals Is All About
title: What Cardinality Estimation Internals Is All About
description: Estimating intermediate result sizes: sampling, sketches, and learned models.. This database covers Cardinality Estimation Internals with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. The planner's job is to pick the cheapest plan, not the perfect plan.
definition: Cardinality Estimation Internals — Estimating intermediate result sizes: sampling, sketches, and learned models.
key_points: The planner's job is to pick the cheapest plan, not the perfect plan.
Cardinality estimation is the hardest problem in query optimization.
Stale statistics cause more bad plans than any other single factor.
Join order dominates cost; the planner searches it with dynamic programming.
how_it_works: Capture the slow query and its EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) output.
Compare estimated vs actual rows at each node; find the misestimate.
Check table statistics: when was ANALYZE last run? Are they stale?
Look for missing indexes on join and filter columns.
Check for correlated columns; create extended statistics if needed.
Simplify: break the query apart and plan the pieces.
Test rewrites: decorrelate subqueries, push down predicates.
Lock in the good plan with baselines or hints only after fixing the root cause.
